name: baoyu-design
summary: Agent skill that runs Claude Design locally to make UI mockups, prototypes, wireframes and decks as HTML.
description: Packages Claude Design as a portable agent skill for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and other file-capable agents. Produces self-contained HTML deliverables — hi-fi mockups, interactive prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, mobile apps and slide decks — with built-in design systems, Figma .fig and GitHub imports, and export to PDF, PPTX, MP4 video, Figma or Canva.
contains: packages Claude Design as a portable agent skill
built-in skills: hi-fi design, prototype, wireframe, decks, mobile, motion, email, illustration, data viz
design systems: create, use, and import from Figma .fig, GitHub repos or HTML/CSS
exports: standalone HTML, PDF, editable PPTX, MP4 video, Figma, Canva
install via npx skills or by handing the repo URL to an agent
